target_counts_after_parameter_substituti.counting_rule: Count each matrix row once by effective_status. QUALIFIED_COMPLETE is an effective completed row but never rewrites an original provider refusal, native ERROR, timeout, transport failure, or method limitation. Counts are not model votes.

row_field_rules.provider_returned_identity: Keep null unless a provider-origin receipt explicitly returns an underlying identity. A requested model, accepted local selection, CLI init tuple, display selection, or coordinator identity is not a provider-returned identity. All five DAYBREAK rows remain null.
row_field_rules.limitations: Append-only union. Preserve every existing matrix limitation verbatim, then append the selected-variant qualifications below. Do not replace historical wording with a cleaner summary.
row_field_rules.historical_outcomes: Append-only array of original refusals, blockers, timeouts, ERROR receipts, failed continuations, and superseded attempts. No historical outcome is relabeled successful.
row_field_rules.evidence: Use audit-root-relative paths. receipt.kind may be completion_receipt, status_receipt, adjudication_receipt, seal_verification_receipt, sealed_first_pass_used_as_receipt, or consolidated_provider_first_pass_used_as_receipt. Do not call a report a completion receipt when none exists.
row_field_rules.effective_status: One of COMPLETE, QUALIFIED_COMPLETE, PROVIDER_REJECTED. This is the sole final count field.
row_field_rules.workflow_status: Set COMPLETE for COMPLETE or QUALIFIED_COMPLETE; set INCOMPLETE for PROVIDER_REJECTED.
row_field_rules.execution_state: Set SEALED only when the selected evidence pair exists and verifies; otherwise PROVIDER_REJECTED for the three terminal OpenAI refusals. Never use SEALED for the parameterized Claude OpenKritt row before its final seal verifies.
row_field_rules.selected_attempt: Normalize to an audit-root-relative path, even where the old matrix used a bare attempt name.
row_field_rules.validation_evidence: May be retained for compatibility, but evidence is the authoritative structured replacement. Do not drop old validation_evidence entries.
